title: Neurologist steers Jim toward John Mack and Ray Fowler
place_text: Boston area, Massachusetts (Beth Israel / Harvard Medical School; Marriott hotel conference)

tellings.quote: few days later he came into my room and said look you know this guy named Ray Fowler Raymond Fowler is going to he's a UFO investigator and he's going to be at this um conference

plain: Jim Weiner, one of the men in what is called the Allagash case, a 1976 account of men who say they were taken by beings, says that years later a neurologist in the Boston area pointed him toward help. He says the doctor told him about Raymond Fowler, a UFO investigator who was coming to a conference at a hotel, and also toward John Mack of Harvard. This, he says, is how his story first reached serious investigators.
